Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for this game. Three easy wins for Australia Women and they are sitting pretty on top of the table in Group A. On Friday, 17th February, a couple of matches are lined up - New Zealand Women vs Bangladesh Women at 6.30 pm IST (1 pm GMT) and West Indies Women vs Ireland Women at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT). Do join us in advance for our build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Meg Lanning, the captain of Australia Women,  says that it was a great game. Adds that Grace Harris standing up to bowl and taking some wickets showcases the depth they have. She adds that people standing up at different times is the strength of her team, just like how Grace stood up today. She also states that she has enjoyed the conditions here but they are ready to take whatever the conditions are. Tells that they are looking forward to playing South Africa Women in their home conditions after getting a day's break. Signs off by saying that the support has been incredible.

Chamari Athapaththu, the captain of Sri Lanka Women, says that they needed to score 150 plus on this wicket. Mentions that the Aussies have a really strong batting unit and a score of 112 wasn't good enough. She adds that they are doing well in the Powerplay but not in overs 6 to 15 and that's where they are losing out. Feels that the bowlers need to take wickets early on as that's the only way they can defend any total.

For three stumpings and 54 unbeaten runs with the bat, Alyssa Healy is picked for the Player of the Match award. Says that it was tough going at times but nice to get the win and nice to have a good game as a unit. On her opening partner, she adds that they complement each other really well and Beth Mooney makes life easy for her at the top as she hits the gaps well and this gives her a chance to play her strokes freely. Shares that the wicket is playing well and the team is chasing down well so she is happy that things are going nicely. Boasts about Australia's bench strength by saying that someone like Jess Jonassen is not getting a chance. Also adds that the spin department is doing well and they are gelling well as a unit. Cites Grace Harris as an example who turned up and picked wickets. Healy feels that they are heading in the right direction.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

There was no spark in the performance of Sri Lanka Women. They needed a good total on the board to challenge the Aussies with their spinners but once Chamari Athapaththu got dismissed, their batting inning lost all the momentum. The Lankans huffed and puffed past the 100-run mark but that was never going to be enough to bother the defending champions. Australia Women have now won 14 consecutive games chasing a target in T20Is and they are on a hot streak.

The defending champions continue to steamroll the teams in their group! Yet another commanding show from them - both with the ball and bat. They had a paltry target to chase and the pair of Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney scaled it down without breaking a sweat. Mooney spent some valuable time in the middle and regained her lost touch.

Australia Women win by 10 wickets! Floated delivery, full and on middle, Alyssa Healy skips down the track and eases it to long on for a run. They have chased down the target with 25 balls to spare. Dominance.

Scores are levelled! Loopy and full, around middle, Beth Mooney jumps down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single. There is a misfield but Alyssa Healy is not interested in taking the second run.
Bowls it short and wide outside off, Alyssa slaps it towards extra cover and takes a run.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Flighted and full, around off, Beth Mooney shimmies down the track and lofts it clinically over extra cover for a boundary. Another boundary away!
FIFTY FOR BETH MOONEY! Her 16th in T20Is. Loopy and full, around off, Beth walks forward and lofts it down to long off for a single. She is back in form and Australia Women will be delighted.
Stays on 49! Quicker one on the pads, Mooney works it around but finds short fine leg.
Uses his feet to advance down the track and then whips a full ball to deep backward square leg for a single. 9 needed more.
Short and close to off, Mooney steps down the track and plays it down to point for one.
Drags her length short, around middle and spinning in, Healy goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a single.
Moves to 48! Short and outside off, Mooney punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Malsha Shehani is back on.
A low full toss on middle, Alyssa keeps it out to covers. Chamari Athapaththu runs across to her left and stops the ball. 13 needed more.
FOUR! Put away in style and Alyssa Healy brings up her 14th T20I fifty. Flatter and shorter around middle and leg, Healy plays the reverse-batted shot and whacks it to through point.
Whoa! What happened there? This one reached the batter on a couple of bounces, outside off and it's left alone. Called a no ball. Free Hit coming up.
Uses her feet to a full ball and works it towards wide long on for a single.
Loopy and around off, Mooney tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes safely to short third man.
Very full and around leg, Healy walks forward and tries to flick but gets a soft leading edge. It rolls towards covers and they steal a single. Both batters are on the same score, 46.
Loopy one, full and around leg, Mooney uses her feet and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Flatter and fuller, around off, Healy skips down the track and drills it towards wide long off for a couple. 21 needed more.
Fuller and on off, Mooney walks forward and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Flatter through the air, short and outside off, Beth Mooney charges down the track and lofts it cleanly over mid off for a boundary.
Quicker one, full and around leg, Healy advances down the track and sweeps it behind square leg for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Beth cuts it to the left of the point fielder for one. She moves to 40.
Tossed up outside off, fuller in length, Healy strokes it to deep cover for a single. Moves to 42.

Shout for an lbw! Floated and outside leg, fuller in length, Mooney tries to sweep but misses. The batter is hit on the pads, they appeal but the umpire shakes her head. Chamari Athapaththu wants this to get reviewed. The UltraEdge takes time to load but finds nothing and the Ball Tracking confirms that it had pitched outside the line of the leg stump. A review more in desperation than anything else.
Flighted delivery, full and following the batter down the leg side. Healy eases it to long on for a single.
Quicker outside off, tapped down to cover-point for a run.
Loopy and full, around off, Alyssa gets forward and wrists it through wide mid on for one.
Quicker one, a shade short on off, Healy gets back and punches it towards the bowler.
Flatter and shorter, on off, Mooney goes back and forces it down to long on for a run.
Chamari Athapaththu brings herself into the attack.
Short and on off, spinning in, Healy goes back and punches but finds cover-point. 35 needed off 54 balls.
Slower one, short and on off, Beth punches it to the right of the cover fielder for a single.
Fuller and outside off, Mooney goes hard at it and drags it off the inner edge to mid on.
Flighted and full, outside off, Beth drives but finds extra cover.
Short in length, around leg and skidding down, Mooney goes back to pull but finds short fine leg.
Loopy around middle, Healy gets back and helps it through mid-wicket for a single.

Drinks break. Easy going for Australia Women. Their openers have combined for a superb partnership and are taking the defending champions towards a comfortable win. Nothing to talk about Sri Lanka Women's bowling here. Just going through the motions and waiting for the game to get over.
Short and wide outside off, Beth Mooney has cut this straight towards the fielder at point.
Short from Inoka Ranaweera, Alyssa Healy punches it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Beth Mooney has punched this through covers for a single.
FOUR! Wonderful footwork again from Beth Mooney. Full and floated, outside off, Mooney walks forward and chips it over extra cover for a boundary.
Alyssa Healy looks in a hurry to wrap this up. Tossed up around off, Alyssa Healy walks down the track and chips it over the cover region for a couple of runs.
Slower through the air around the pads, Beth Mooney has worked this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and on off, Beth Mooney has pushed this towards long on for a single. 45 needed off 66 balls.
Full toss on her pads, Alyssa Healy has flicked this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Effortless! Achini delivers it on a good length outside off, Alyssa Healy dances down the track and lofts it nonchalantly over long off for a maximum.

Chance of a run out! Full and wide outside off, Beth Mooney walks toward this and guides this to the fielder at point. There is a bit of hesitation and then they go for the run. The point fielder misses her shy at the striker's end and Healy survives.

FOUR! Lovely placement! Achini Kulasuriya dishes out a full toss around middle, Beth Mooney uses her feet and whips it past the left side of the mid on fielder for a boundary, her fourth in this knock.
Back of a length around off, Alyssa Healy has tapped it towards point and they steal a single.
Achini Kulasuriya is back on. None for 8 in her one over so far.
Length delivery outside off, Alyssa Healy has punched this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around her pads, Alyssa Healy walks down the track to block this out with a front-foot defensive stroke.
FOUR! Innovative! The 50-run stand comes up. Tossed up around off, Alyssa Healy brings out the reverse-batted shot and nails it through backward point for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, Alyssa Healy gives a shimmy down the ground and she has smashed this over the fielder at mid on for a couple of runs.
On a length just outside off, Alyssa Healy has punched this towards short cover.
Tossed up around the pads, Beth Mooney has nudged this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Inoka Ranaweera comes into the attack.
Flatter trajectory this time around off, Beth Mooney has punched this towards the off side for a single at deep cover.
Short and wide outside off, Beth Mooney has cut this towards deep backward point for a couple of runs.
Flighted delivery, full and around leg, Healy flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up on her pads, Beth Mooney walks down the track and flicks this towards the on side for a single.

FOUR! Timing and placement Beth Mooney is gaining some valuable form here. She walks forward to a delivery outside off, takes it on the full and caresses it through extra cover. The fielder at long off rushes across to her right, puts in a dive but to no use.
Flighted on and around off, Beth Mooney has pushed this towards mid on for no run.
Full and wide around off, Beth Mooney has steered it square of the wicket on the off side for a single. Powerplay is done and Australia Women are well on the course here.
Wide! Length delivery down leg, Beth Mooney looks to flick but misses out.
On a length around her pads, Beth Mooney has glanced this towards deep square leg for a couple.
Short and wide outside off, Alyssa Healy has cut this towards sweeper cover for a single.
Touch fuller around pads, Beth Mooney has flicked this towards short mid-wicket for a single.
On a length around off, Alyssa Healy taps this towards the on side for a single.
Length delivery drifting down leg, Beth Mooney has nudged this away towards deep square leg for a single.
Achini Kulasuriya is into the attack to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
Finally a run is scored against a bowler bowling from this end. Flatter and on off, Mooney taps it down to short cover and rushes across to the other end.
Drags the length short and delivers it outside off, Beth cuts but finds point.
Short and on off, punched to cover-point.
Walks forward and yorks herself. Beth drives it back and the bowler dives to her right to make a half-stop. She parries it behind and the extra cover fielder does the mopping up.
Short and on off, skidding in, Mooney forces it off the back foot to extra cover.
Extra flight on this delivery, full and on off, Mooney pushes it back to the bowler.
Malsha Shehani is into the attack.

FOUR! And again! Consecutive boundaries and Australia Women are going along strongly. Loopy delivery, full and outside off, Healy is again down the track as he clubs it down to long on for a boundary. 13 from the over, the floodgates have opened. 85 needed off 96 balls.
FOUR! Shot! Floated and full, landing around off, Alyssa Healy wears her skates and pumps it over mid on for a boundary. After playing out a maiden, Healy needed this boundary.
Shortish and on off, Mooney goes on the back foot and hits it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! This will break the shackles. Too straight and short, Beth Mooney goes deep inside the crease and powers it behind square leg for a boundary.
Tossed up around middle, defended to mid-wicket.
Short in length, around off, punched to covers.
MAIDEN! Sugandika Kumari serves it full and outside off, gets it to straighten a bit, Healy tries to defend but misses. Top over!
Flatter one, on middle, Alyssa goes on the back foot and defends it on the leg side.
Make it four dots. Loopy and full, outside off, Healy drives but finds short cover.
Three dots. Flatter arm ball around off, skidding in, Healy tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Arm ball, around off, defended to the left of the bowler.
Play and a miss! Width there outside off, fuller in length Alyssa Healy tries to drive but misses.
Flighted and outside off, Beth pushes it to short cover and steps out for a run. This time Healy sends her partner back.
On middle, Mooney helps it towards square leg. Healy wants a run but is sent back.
Advances down the track and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, punched back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Oshadi pulls back her length a bit and delivers it outside off, Healy steps down the track and then tries to cut but misses. The keeper collects the ball and then takes the bails off before jumping in joy. Alyssa also drags her back leg inside the crease and is looking confident. The third umpire is referred to. She first checks for the outside edge, which is absent. The side-on angle shows that Healy has grounded her back foot. Sri Lanka Women have seen that and already taken their field positions.
Stumping appeal. It has been referred upstairs...

FOUR! Australia Women are scoring a lot more freely compared to the last game. Full toss around leg, Healy jumps down the track and lofts it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder dives near the fence but to no avail.
Who will bowl from the opposite end? It's Oshadi Ranasinghe.
FOUR! Beth Mooney is also off the mark with a boundary. Tossed up, full and around leg, this time Beth doesn't miss out. She kneels down and nails her sweep shot behind square leg for a boundary.
Flighted and full, outside off, Beth drives but finds the fielder at covers.
Loopy and full, around middle, Mooney pushes it back to the bowler with a straight bat.
Wide! Down the leg side, Beth tries to sweep but misses.
Short and around off, Mooney goes on the back foot and defends it back.
Flatter and shorter, on middle, Healy goes back and taps it down to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Australia Women are underway immediately. Flighted delivery, full and around leg, Alyssa Healy leans across in her stance and flicks it beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
